<!--
Minimal quarto-live boot include for pages that only need climt imported.

Include it once, near the top of any `format: live-html` / `engine: jupyter`
page, with a Quarto include shortcode pointing at this file (see
modelling-tour/01-emissivity-spectrum.qmd for the exact line). Do NOT repeat
the literal include shortcode in this comment: Quarto resolves include
shortcodes at the text level, before HTML comments are stripped, so a literal
one here would make this file include itself.

This is the tour's counterpart to climt-live-setup.qmd. That file also defines
the ~200-line `integrate_with_snapshots` / `integrate_to_equilibrium` helpers
for the RCE pages, and its cell carries `#| edit: false`, which quarto-live
renders **read-only, not hidden** — so including it opened every modelling-tour
page with four screens of RCE code that none of those pages calls. The two
files deliberately duplicate these few import lines rather than chaining one
include into the other, so that neither page family can break the other.

The climt wheel itself is installed by micropip at document setup via the
including page's `pyodide: packages:` front-matter block — resolved from PyPI,
pinned to a released version. (GitHub release assets cannot be used: they send
no CORS headers. A CORS-served localhost wheel is the way to preview
unreleased work.)
-->

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
# The climt wheel is installed by micropip at document setup (before any cell
# runs) via the `pyodide: packages:` block in the page front matter. Installing
# here with `await micropip.install(...)` instead would race: quarto-live does
# not await one autorun cell's async work before starting the next, so a
# downstream cell can run before the wheel finishes installing. So this cell is
# synchronous.
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import climt
import sympl

# End on a plain statement (not a def): quarto-live captures each cell's final
# value for display, and marshalling a bare function object through JS interop
# yields an unhashable JsProxy that aborts the cell.
print("climt", climt.__version__, "ready — has_fortran:", climt.has_fortran_extensions())
```
